default/30639.htm.text: Summoner Celestiel: This was where the stadium of the empirical era stood. Even today... Don't you think it'd be a good place to hold a battle? Like a Summoner's duel, for instance... Ah, excuse me for my late introduction. I am Celestiel the Summoner. And that is my comrade Pantersm, the unicorn. …

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30639-01.html.text: Summoner Celestiel: How do you do? I am Celestiel the Summoner. This is my comrade Phantasm the unicorn. This place seems good for a battle, doesn't it? What do you think, apprentice Summoner?

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30639-05.html.text: Summoner Celestiel: Ah, yes, I win again... My Unicorn Phantasm is a powerful opponent, no? A weak creature like yours is no match for him.

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30639-06.html.text: Summoner Celestiel: Watch out Phantasm! ...Are you hurt? What the hell are you doing! How dare you touch my animal! You forfeit the match for that... Give me your crude little card...

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30639-07.html.text: Summoner Celestiel: Oh, my! My poor Unicorn Phantasm! I pray he isn't badly injured! Wow, what a battle! I never imagined such a weak animal would get the better of my Phantasm! Oh, well, I suppose everyone has to lose sometimes. Take my Arcana Card . Take heed, this is the first and the last time …

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30639-10.html.text: Summoner Celestiel: I hope you are taking care of my Arcana Card... Are you still taking the Trial of the Summoner? If you defeat me and then lose to others I will be doubly disgraced. I pray you achieve straight victories and earn the Mark of the Summoner!

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30639-02.html.text: Summoner Celestiel: You cannot issue a challenge without an Arcana Card. Trader Lara of the Town of Dion will make one for you.

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30639-03.html.text: Summoner Celestiel: You are allowed the first attack and must never touch your opponent's creature. Are you ready? Let's make this a good battle!

Q00230_TestOfTheSummoner/30639-04.html.text: Summoner Celestiel: First I will need your Arcana Card. I believe in you, Unicorn Phantasm! Take your time... Keep your eyes on your opponent!
